steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Big Bang theory states the universe began from an extremely hot, dense singularity ~13.8 billion years ago

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Hubble's law: v = H₀d — recession velocity is proportional to distance; further galaxies recede faster

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Cosmological redshift occurs because space itself is expanding, stretching light to longer wavelengths

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The cosmic microwave background (CMB) is the afterglow of the Big Bang, at ~2.7 K

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: State Hubble's law and define each term. | Q: What is the cosmic microwave background? | Q: How does redshift support the Big Bang theory?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: v = H₀d, where v is recession velocity (km/s), H₀ is the Hubble constant (~70 km/s/Mpc), and d is distance (Mpc). | Radiation from ~380,000 years after the Big Bang when the universe became transparent. It has been redshifted by expansion to microwave wavelengths at ~2.7 K. | Virtually all distant galaxies show redshift, indicating they are moving away from us — evidence the universe is expanding. If we rewind this expansion, everything converges to a single point ~13.8 bi

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Hubble's law: v = H₀d — know the formula and units CMB temperature: ~2.7 K (nearly 3 K) — this is a common recall question Three key pieces of evidence for the Big Bang: redshift, CMB, abundance of light elements (H, He) Olbers' paradox is specifically on the Edexcel specification
